result.justification: The review clearly articulates a purpose in assessing the trafficking and activation mechanisms of Henipavirus F proteins, supported by a structured synthesis of existing knowledge.

objective_evidence.quote: the purpose of this review is to provide a comprehensive analysis of current knowledge regarding the distinctive trafficking and activation mechanisms of the F proteins of Henipaviruses

method_evidence.quote: we discuss the unique characteristics of henipavirus F proteins compared to other paramyxovirus fusion proteins
